hash-chain.title: Complete integer map: separate chaining
preconditions: Integer keys and values in ±100000. Initialize an empty map first; these example maps hold up to 32 distinct keys, with capacity 8..64. The interactive input has at most 16 initial pairs plus one operation.
Duplicate insertion updates; missing lookup is distinct from a stored zero. Probing stops after at most capacity inspections.
notes: Chaining C allocates nodes and requires map_free after successful map_init. C++ vectors own their entries; Java/Python/JavaScript use managed storage.
The C lookup returns a success boolean and writes an output parameter. Other examples use optional/null/None for missing integer values.
Rehashing recomputes buckets and removes tombstones. The live-load threshold is 0.75.
Chaining examples with collection buckets may shift a bucket list on deletion; the C linked representation unlinks nodes. Both traverse colliding keys, with linear worst-case bucket work.
hash-chain.time: Expected O(1) under distribution/load assumptions; O(n) worst-case operation; rehash O(n+capacity)
hash-chain.space: O(n+capacity) map storage; rehash temporarily holds old and new storage
